map.偏好分布：各口味得票率 = 该口味票数 ÷ 总票数 × 100%；平均评分 =: Preference distribution: vote share of each taste = votes for that taste ÷ total votes × 100%; average rating = Σrating ÷ number of raters; the modal taste is the one with the most votes; use the distribution to identify the salty / sweet / spicy preferences of your customer base and iterate the menu and new items. Data stays local and is never uploaded.

map.收集一段时间后看各口味的分布比例，判断主力客群偏好，指导菜单调整。: After collecting for a while, look at the distribution ratio of each taste to judge the main customer preference and guide menu adjustments.

map.），页面实时汇总成分布图表与占比。例如某店累计 120 条中\"微辣\"占 42: ), and the page aggregates in real time into a distribution chart with percentages. For example, of 120 records at a store "mild spicy" takes 42%, "not spicy" 33% and "hot" 25%, meaning the core customers accept spice but prefer mild levels, so new items should lead with mild spicy and offer hot as a minority option. A mis-tap can undo the last entry, or you can clear everything and start collecting again.
map.数据存在哪里、会上传吗？: Where is the data stored, and is it uploaded?
map.只存在当前浏览器的 localStorage 中，不会上传到任何服务器，也不跨设: Only in this browser localStorage. It is never uploaded to any server and does not sync across devices. Clearing browser data or switching devices loses the records, so export anything important and keep it yourself.
map.能区分不同门店或时段吗？: Can I distinguish stores or time slots?
map.不能。工具只按口味累计条数，不区分门店、时段或菜品。需要分维度分析时，请按不同维: No. The tool only counts entries per taste and does not separate store, time slot or dish. For multi-dimensional analysis, record each dimension separately or export and process it in a spreadsheet.
